messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased tail latency detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2. p95 trending ~1.4s (baseline ~400ms). Paging lina_oncall and rahul_sre.

lina_oncall: Ack. Pulling dashboards and traces. Anyone seen deployments or infra changes in us-west-2 over the last hour?

rahul_sre: Looking at node metrics now. p50 ~320ms, p95 ~1.4s, p99 up to 2.4s. Onset around 13:07 UTC. No spike in 5xxs.

anya_runtime: We applied a security kernel update to a subset of inference hosts at 12:50 UTC (linux-5.19.12-rt) that required reboots. Not all nodes were hit in the first wave.

mike_perf: Perf summary from inf-w2-14 during the window:
```
# perf stat -e context-switches,softirqs,cpu-clock -p <pid>
context-switches: 1,102,344
softirqs: 289,100
cpu-clock: 3.1e9
```
Also captured perf record; flamegraphs in progress.

rahul_sre: Traces show long pre-dispatch waits. Example trace id trace-0xface: sched_wait 610ms -> app_queue 90ms -> dispatch 40ms. Also seeing increased time in kernel wakeup/rv runqueue.

lina_oncall: Customer impact: telemetry shows ~12% of generate requests in us-west-2 >1s in the last 20m. Two enterprise customers opened tickets reporting degraded interactivity.

kelly_support: Posting a short customer advisory now: "We are investigating elevated latency in the generate endpoint for us-west-2. Some customers may notice slower responses; no data loss." Notifying account teams.

anya_runtime: Hypotheses: (A) kernel RT/preempt interaction changed runqueue behavior under our workload; (B) NIC driver update causing softirq backlog; (C) subtle change in cpuset/affinity after reboot.

mike_perf: dmesg excerpts from inf-w2-14 and inf-w2-15 during the period show RCU/stall-like messages and kworker warnings:
```
[13:06:55] RCU detected stall on CPUs 2-5
[13:07:30] INFO: task kworker/2:3: blocked for 21s
```

rahul_sre: Collecting /proc/sched_debug, /proc/interrupts, and iostat. /proc/sched_debug shows elevated nr_switches and runqueue latency. /proc/interrupts shows large softirq counts on eth0.

lina_oncall: Mitigation options: 1) rollback kernel on affected nodes (reboots) 2) cordon/drain affected nodes and shift traffic to spare pool 3) apply router split to other region 4) reduce runtime batch sizes or reduce concurrency per-worker.

anya_runtime: Fastest steps: router split + runtime config hotpatch to reduce max_batch_size and per-worker concurrency. We also have a spare pool we can scale up in us-east-1.

mike_perf: I'll prepare the hotpatch to set max_batch_size=3 and max_concurrency_per_worker=6 for gen models in us-west-2. Also building flamegraphs and perf.data for the incident folder.

rahul_sre: I'll cordon inf-w2-14 and inf-w2-15 and drain them to test impact. If p95 improves substantially, that points to host-level regressions.

anya_runtime: Applying router rule now: 20% split for /v1/generate -> us-east-1-dedicated. Hotpatching runtime config with batch/concurrency caps.

mike_perf: Hotpatch deployed. Starting collection of perf.data and running a synthetic streaming workload against a repro node.

lina_oncall: Early results: after cordon/drain and hotpatch, p95 improved from 1.4s -> 640ms over ~3 minutes. p50 stable. Router split still ramping.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation recorded: cordon inf-w2-14,inf-w2-15; runtime hotpatch max_batch_size=3,max_concurrency_per_worker=6; router split 20% to us-east-1. Incident ticket INC-2026-719 created.

rahul_sre: Residual tail reduced but not fully at baseline. Starting an isolated repro by booting a sandbox node with linux-5.19.12-rt and running sustained inference load to reproduce scheduling/RCU stalls.

mike_perf: Repro confirms increased runqueue latency and RCU stall traces under high-sustained streaming load on patched kernel. Softirq backlog visible in perf and /proc/softirqs.

anya_runtime: Given repro, immediate plan: keep current mitigations (router split + batch/concurrency caps + cordoned nodes). Medium term: schedule rollback patch for affected hosts during maintenance window and run canary with controlled load. Long term: escalate to kernel/vendor with perf traces and dmesg logs, consider tuning NO_HZ or preempt configs.

kelly_support: Updated customer advisory: "Mitigations in place, partial traffic rerouted; p95 improved but some workloads may still see elevated latency. We will follow up with a postmortem by EOD." Notifying impacted customers.

lina_oncall: I'm compiling the incident timeline and artifacts into /incidents/2360009999. Please upload perf.data, flamegraphs, dmesg snippets, and repro scripts. Handoff to rahul_sre for RCA write-up.

rahul_sre: Acknowledged. Taking ownership of RCA. Will include timeline, relevant dmesg snippets, perf stat/flamegraphs, tracing spans, mitigation timeline, customer impact (approx 12% >1s), and repro steps.

mike_perf: Uploading perf.data and flamegraphs plus the synthetic repro script to the incident folder.

anya_runtime: I'll drop the runtime hotpatch diffs, router rule JSON, and rollback playbook into the folder.

lina_oncall: Final note: no errors observed, only tail latency regressions; mitigations rapidly improved SLOs but root cause likely kernel-level scheduler/RCU interaction after the 5.19.12-rt update. Handoff complete. :page_with_curl:
